messages:
ashley: Heads up — we just got a spike of `payment-relay-error` alerts but the on-call didn't get paged. Can folks check the paging path?

sre-bot: ALERT: payment-relay-error (sev3) x12 in 2m. Attempted paging via sms-relay (relay-bot) — 0 successes.

mike: seeing same. Relay service logs show repeated 502s when posting to the SMS gateway. No PagerDuty incident created.

relay-bot: failed to deliver page to +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX: upstream 502 (POST /send). Request id: rly-7f3a2.

devon: PagerDuty shows nothing on our side — webhook didn't drop into PD. Could be our relay proxy rejecting requests before PD integration.

ashley: @mike can you try a manual page and also run the relay liveness check? Need to know if it's automation-only or full outage. :eyes:

mike: running quick check: `curl -v https://relay.internal/send -d '{"to":"+1-xxx","msg":"test"}'` -> upstream 502.

mike: manual page via PD web UI succeeded for the on-call group (jordan-oncall) — jordan acked. So manual path works, automation path failing. :+1:

sam: possible pattern — we rolled relay-splitter v3.6 earlier today. It added an outbound connection pool change. If pool is exhausted we see 502s. Recommend pausing automation (disable relay-splitter rule) while we investigate.

devon: investigating the deploy. Checking k8s: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=relay-splitter` -> 3/3 Running but restartcount high on one pod. Fetching logs...

devon: logs show repeated `net/http: request canceled` then `upstream: 502`. Also saw `connection pool exhausted` traces.

ashley: OK, @sam please pause the automation rule in console (disable 'auto-page via sms-relay') and @devon prepare rollback if needed. I'll notify support to manual page until cleared.

sam: rule paused. Confirmed automation OFF in Console > Routing > Outbound Rules.

mike: created PD incident manually and added brief note: "Paging automation failed; manual pages in effect; rolling back relay-splitter". Incident link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

devon: rolling back relay-splitter to v3.5.2 now: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/relay-splitter relay-splitter=registry.redwood/relay-splitter:v3.5.2`

relay-bot: healthcheck passed after new pods up. No 502s observed in the last 60s.

mike: confirmed automation still paused. Jordan (oncall) says alerts stopped flooding and latency normalized.

ashley: good. Immediate mitigation: rollback complete, automation paused, manual paging until follow-up. Customer impact: a subset of webhook deliveries to downstream partners were delayed ~2-7 minutes for ~5% of traffic during the window. No data loss reported.

devon: collecting metrics and logs for postmortem. Putting a quick runbook note in the incident: root cause suspected connection pool regression in v3.6. Follow-ups: 1) add pool size health check, 2) add graceful fallback to PD if relay returns 502, 3) add runbook step to toggle automation rule quickly.

ashley: assigning follow-ups to @sam (healthchecks + runbook) and @devon (fix and test v3.6 locally). I'll own the postmortem.

jordan-oncall: thanks everyone — I got paged manually and handled acknowledgements. No customer-facing escalations so far.

mike: marking this thread resolved for live mitigation. We'll keep the PD incident open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Filing postmortem template now. TL; DR for ops channel: automation failed to send pages due to relay-splitter v3.6 connection pool regression; rollback and manual paging mitigated impact.

sre-bot: Note: remember to attach logs: `relay-splitter-logs-2890123456.tar.gz` and metrics snapshot `relay-metrics-2890123600.json` to the PD incident.

ashley: thanks. Closing thread for live coordination — follow-ups tracked in PD.
